sheet-9999997.description: The New Bridge section of the Borough of New Milford, Bergen County, on the east bank of the Hackensack River, drawn at 100 feet to an inch on a sheet turned on the page so that north points to its right-hand edge. The river runs across the top of the sheet with the New Bridge crossing it at the upper left, where the borough line between New Milford and Teaneck Township runs down the middle of New Bridge Road. The Borough of Riverdale and Teaneck Township are lettered across the river. Along New Bridge Road near the bridge stand the New Bridge Hotel, a canoe club on the river bank and a row of summer houses, with a fire house of the Defender Hose Co. No. 1 further south. East of Brookside Avenue the sheet is a laid-out subdivision: blocks 148 to 162 of numbered lots between Steuben (Riverside) Avenue, Lynnwood Avenue, Roosevelt (Prospect) Avenue and Willow Avenue, crossed by Clinton, Arlington and Maple Avenues, with only a few scattered dwellings built. The middle of the sheet is open land marked Sec. 6 and Sec. 7, crossed by long lot lines and a few dwellings and poultry houses, with River Road running across it below. At the lower left, small lots line Riverview Avenue, Lark, Cottage Place (marked not open), Springfield Avenue and 1st and 2nd Streets; at the lower right Richmond Avenue, Virginia and 1st Street form another platted tract. A 30 inch water pipe follows River Road. The right edge is marked as having no exposures. Most of the platted streets in the upper right and lower left were never built as drawn; the modern street layout there differs.
notes: Printed sheet number 10; the canvas label (9999997) does not match.
Lynnwood Avenue is Lynwood Avenue in OpenStreetMap.
Steuben Avenue is also labelled Riverside Avenue, Roosevelt Avenue also Prospect Avenue, and the street at the lower right edge is labelled only as (Bergen Av.).
Willow Avenue, Lark, Springfield Avenue, 1st Street and 2nd Street are not in OpenStreetMap at their drawn positions; the area is now built over with another street plan.
Buildings of note: New Bridge Hotel, a canoe club, Defender Hose Co. No. 1 fire house.

Printed sheet 10 of New Milford, 'New Bridge Section', Aug. 1930 (canvas label 9999997 is odd; id kept). Scale 100 ft to an inch; one part, map fills the sheet; north arrow points to the right of the page (sheet turned). Hackensack River and New Bridge at top; New Bridge Rd, Brookside Av, Steuben (Riverside) Av, Lynnwood, Roosevelt (Prospect), Clinton, Arlington, Maple, Willow Avs; River Rd, Cottage Pl, Lark, Riverview Av, Springfield Av, 1st and 2nd Sts at lower left; Richmond Av, Virginia, 1st St and Bergen Av at lower right. Willow Av, Springfield Av, 1st/2nd Sts and Lark are not in OpenStreetMap.
